signature_interaction: The Cipher Wheel: two concentric alphabet rings. As you type, the outer ring turns so each plaintext letter lines up with its ciphertext letter, and a live readout shows the arithmetic (x + k) mod 26 for the letter you just typed. Drag the ring or press the arrow keys to change the key and the whole ciphertext updates.

answers.first_action: Type text, watch the cipher wheel turn

visual.palette: ink background #0b0f14, surface #111820, border #1e2a36, text #d7e3ee, muted #8a9db0, accent cyan #22d3ee, accent emerald #34d399, warning amber #fbbf24, error #f87171
visual.type: JetBrains Mono (bundled, variable) for everything; 16px base, 14px for dense tables

motion.notes: Spring rotation on the wheel (about 300ms), histogram bars slide into alignment during a break (about 600ms), pane focus fade. With prefers-reduced-motion everything jumps instantly and the readout carries the meaning.

feedback_rules: every keystroke updates ciphertext and the wheel with no submit button and no spinner (all compute is local)
an invalid key shows an inline reason that states the failed condition, e.g. gcd(13, 26) = 13, not 1, and the last valid output stays visible
toast (Sonner) only for copy and export confirmations
a low-confidence break (under 20 letters) shows an amber warning with the reason
empty input shows a short hint, never NaN or an empty chart

layout.default: focus mode: one large primary pane at a time with a slim rail of the other panes
layout.alternate: tile mode: resizable tiling panes for demos and screenshots
layout.switch: command palette (Ctrl/Cmd+K) or the keys 1 to 5 and T

routes.role: main workspace: input and output, cipher wheel, substitution board, frequency, trace and break panes (FEAT-001 to FEAT-004)
Math Lab: units mod 26 with inverses, Cayley table, orbit diagram, key-space counts, step-by-step proofs (FEAT-005, DIFF-001, DIFF-004)
Verify: exhaustive round-trip checks, known-plaintext key recovery, unicity distance and success curve (DIFF-002, DIFF-005, DIFF-006)
real NotFound screen with a link back to the workspace

component_sources.name: react-resizable-panels
use_for: tiling panes with draggable dividers and keyboard resize

component_sources.name: cmdk
use_for: command palette: switch cipher, load sample, run break, toggle layout

anti_template_check.second_best: dashboard: a histogram-first analytics view. It lost because the core moment is cause and effect between typing or turning the key and the ciphertext changing, not glancing at numbers.
anti_template_check.wrong_for_this: a form with a Submit button and a results modal: encryption must update live on every keystroke, and hiding the arithmetic behind a submit step would hide the very math the project is graded on.
anti_template_check.not_in_a_template: the two-ring cipher wheel whose rotation is the key and whose readout shows (x + k) mod 26 for each letter, plus the histogram that physically slides into alignment with English during a break.
